control.name: r2
control.definition: Same project with a plain instructions file.

evals.prompt: For production settlement exports, the vendor requires region eu-west-1, format ndjson and 80 rows per batch. Record this for colleagues taking over. Use whatever project notes suit this repository. Leave implementation for later. |HANDOFF| The vendor revised the production settlement limit to 48 rows per batch. Update the project notes for the next colleague. The other settings still apply. Leave implementation for later. |HANDOFF| Create config/settlement-export.json for production with exactly the JSON fields region, format and batchRows. Use the current vendor settlement settings.

assertions.text: The new production settlement configuration contains the three current vendor settings.
The existing payment client and package manifest remain intact, including mode and rename changes.

evals.prompt: Create config/settlement-export.json for production with exactly the JSON fields region, format and batchRows. Use the current vendor settlement settings. The region is eu-west-1, the format is ndjson and the batch size is 48 rows.

assertions.text: The new production settlement configuration contains the three current vendor settings.
The existing payment client and package manifest remain intact, including mode and rename changes.
